# **3 Axial Skyrmions**
- The reflection symmetry in this context alters only one of the pion fields, leading to a relative phase definition that differs by an added π compared to refs. [3, 12, 7], where antiSkyrmions are defined by reversing all three pion fields.
- The adopted definition in this paper aligns more naturally with analogous cases in monopole theory, facilitating clearer comparisons.
- The profile function vanishes at a radius *s/2* from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, ensuring a continuous patching of fields where the vacuum state is maintained outside the cores.

# **(3.10) Initial Conditions and Ansatz**
- Initial conditions were first derived using the simple ansatz outlined in equation (3.7).
- More refined initial conditions were also implemented, leveraging the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge *n* map for improved accuracy.
